confirmationStatistics.method: Equal fixed-cell weights, equal map weights on this balanced grid; all focal seats averaged within each deal. Paired delta formed on identical task/opponent assignments; SE=sqrt(sum_c s_c^2/D_c / C^2), s_c^2 unbiased sample variance (ddof=1), D_c=2 independent deals. Approximate normal mean +/-1.96 SE.
caveats: Exploratory, unadjusted multiple comparisons; two deals per cell give imprecise variance estimates.
No independent training-seed replication; inference is conditional on this selected checkpoint and fixed populations.
Positive map/count/rule aggregates do not imply improvement in every cell; 14 of 120 observed cell means regress.
Germany uses exact reference opponents; other maps use fixed mixed PPO0/1/2, NOT the old reference.
All-map credit is not universal neural-population or human strength; teacher-v2 differs from v1, so earlier raw credits are not a causal comparison.

GermanyAnalyticalReferenceBenchmark.note: Analytical symmetric all-reference all-seat mean 1/n, macro .29; NOT an additional played control. Selected deal averages are compared against that neutral identity. Interval includes zero: no demonstrated superiority to exact reference.
